blocks.text: Original document: [docs/RENDER_TARGET_ARCHITECTURE_AND_API.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/RENDER_TARGET_ARCHITECTURE_AND_API.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.

In WebGPU rendering engines, intermediate render targets (offscreen canvases, persistent textures, frame feedback, and G-Buffers) often suffer from clunky, fragmented APIs requiring manual texture bindings, custom quad shaders, and fragile non-null assertions.

Retiam redesigns the **`RenderTarget`** subsystem around the clean, entity-centric ergonomics of **`Physics3D`**. Instead of forcing users to manage low-level texture handles, bitmasks, and manual scene attachments, `RenderTarget` provides an intuitive, high-level interface:

flowchart TD
    subgraph Initialization ["1. Initialization (Physics3D-Style)"]
        RT["new RenderTarget(scene, options)"]
    end

    subgraph EntityManagement ["2. Entity Registration & Layer Isolation"]
        RT -->|"add(entity)"| AutoLayer["Auto-assign Isolated Layer Bit (Layer 2..31)"]
        AutoLayer --> AutoScene["Auto-register in scene.entities"]
        AutoScene --> MainCam["Main Camera ignores layer automatically"]
    end

    subgraph PipelineSchedule ["3. Zero-Latency Pre-Raster Pipeline"]
        PrePass["Pre-Raster Custom Pass (Offscreen / Persistent)"]
        MainRaster["MainRasterFeature (Scene & Sprites)"]
        PrePass -->|"Write Texture (Current Frame)"| Tex["GPUTexture"]
        Tex -->|"Read Texture (0-Latency)"| MainRaster
    end

    subgraph Consumption ["4. Flexible Texture Consumption"]
        Tex --> SpriteDirect["renderTarget.toSprite() / new Sprite(renderTarget)"]
        Tex --> MatDirect["model.material.texture = renderTarget.texture"]
    end

blocks.text: A. Automatic Layer Isolation & Scene Graph Retention
When an entity is added via `renderTarget.add(entity)`:

items: **Scene Graph Live**: The entity is registered in `scene.entities`. It receives normal `update(t, dt)` ticks, animation callbacks (`scene.always()`, `scene.play()`), state matrix evaluations, and component preparations.
**Main Camera Culling**: The main camera executes `ignoreLayer(allocatedLayer)` so the entity **never** renders directly onto the main canvas.
**Dedicated Pass Drawing**: The RenderTarget’s pass filters the render queue for `(packet.entity.layerMask & this.layerMask) !== 0` and renders it exclusively into the offscreen texture.
**Hierarchical Propagation**: Child entities added to the entity inherit the parent’s layer mask, ensuring complex hierarchies (e.g. text characters, composite models) remain isolated.

blocks.text: Previously, custom passes added to the scene were appended at the end of the FrameGraph (as post-processing). This introduced an inherent **1-frame latency**, because `MainRasterFeature` rendered scene sprites *before* the render target texture was updated.

This guarantees that any Sprite or Material in the main scene sampling `renderTarget.texture` receives the **current frame's fresh render** with zero delay.
A RenderTarget can be immediately used as a 2D or 3D `Sprite` without manual texture binding or non-null assertions:

cells.text: 2D drawing, paint canvases, UI viewports, minimaps.
3D space with 45° FOV and depth buffer. Framed at origin.
Synchronizes with `scene.camera` position, orientation, and FOV, maintaining target aspect ratio.
Identity orthographic mapping without camera translation.
Fullscreen quads, procedural textures, compute blits.
Direct use of a user-configured `Camera` entity.
Custom lenses, multi-camera rigs, specialized angles.
